title: Brazin Ltd - proposed acquisition of HMV Australia Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Brazin Ltd's acquisition of HMV Australia Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC assessed the proposed merger on the basis of a national market for the retail sale of pre-recorded CDs and DVDs (including mail-order sales and online sales of CDs and DVDs).  Given that no competition concerns arose in this market, it was not necessary to consider whether a wider market (for example, including sale by download from the internet) existed.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market because of the existence of a number of large retail competitors and low barriers to entry evidenced by the large number of independent retailers.
